exposure: EUS-guided intraportal autologous bone marrow transplantation (EUS-POV ABMT)
Peripheral autologous bone marrow transplantation (PEV ABMT)
cohort: The study included 65 patients diagnosed with decompensated liver cirrhosis (DLC).
finding: EUS-guided intraportal ABMT is a safe and highly effective treatment for DLC, demonstrating superior benefits over peripheral infusion and conventional treatment, with the cell delivery route being the primary factor for therapeutic efficacy rather than the progenitor cell content.
